summary: Monolith's Blood is a Build-engine horror FPS now preserved through modern Nightdive/Atari releases plus original DOS expansion-content comparison.

entries.title: Blood
entries.definitive_edition: Blood: Refreshed Supply for current access; original DOS/One Unit Whole Blood for behavior comparison

emulation.emulator: None for modern route; DOSBox for original DOS comparison
emulation.notes: Use current remaster for access; record DOSBox/source-port settings if comparing original behavior.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Original DOS release for engine behavior; Refreshed Supply for current official access

primary.version: Blood: Refreshed Supply or Blood: Fresh Supply where applicable
primary.why: Blood: Refreshed Supply is the newest modern route, while Fresh Supply documented the earlier KEX remaster route and included the original Blood plus Plasma Pak and Cryptic Passage. Archive work should distinguish the current remaster from original DOS and prior Fresh Supply builds.
primary.how_to_play: Use Blood: Refreshed Supply if available, or Fresh Supply/owned DOS release as labeled. Record storefront/platform, build, episode/add-on, difficulty, source port/remaster, cut-content/mod scenario state, multiplayer/co-op state, and whether One Unit Whole Blood/DOS was compared.

secondary.exclusive_content: Original Build-engine route and DOS behavior
secondary.what_to_play: Use for original-engine comparison or if the remaster route is unavailable.
secondary.why: Modern remasters alter compatibility, display, input, netcode, and bonus-content state.
